description: Last real conclusion of every job in every push/pull_request workflow. The object list is discovered by parsing .github/workflows, not enumerated here, because the enforcement surface ledger only classifies scripts/qa/* and would never have looked at boundary-coverage, test, clippy, miri or cross-compile. Verified offline by scripts/qa/ci-liveness.rb in the ci.yml governance job; refreshed from `gh run` locally with --refresh --write.

knownFailing.reason: Transient, and self-clearing by this gate's own rule. Retiring two gates changed ci.yml, which makes every liveness record older than the workflow it describes — so the liveness step went red, and it is the only step in the governance job that did. The other 18 jobs in that run concluded success. Refreshing the ledger from that run therefore records `governance: failure`, and a red job needs this annotation in writing. The next run has a fresh ledger, so the liveness step passes, the job concludes success, and the check that a known-failing annotation may not outlive its failure forces this entry to be removed with the refresh that records it. It cannot linger.

workflows.reason: triggered by v* tags and workflow_dispatch only, so it has no last-run-on-main to assert. A release that fails is visible at the moment someone cuts it, and recording a stale tag build here would say less than nothing.
